newmap.title: New map
newmap.intro: Creates a map folder in the maps folder of your OMSI installation. AI lists, drivers, parked cars, holidays and every setting you leave alone come from the template map; its tiles, timetables and entry points do not. The template is not changed.
newmap.template.choose.tooltip: Another map of your installation as template; the new map goes next to it.
newmap.name: Name in OMSI
newmap.name.tooltip: The name OMSI's map list shows
newmap.folder.tooltip: The folder in OMSI's maps folder; follows the name until you change it
newmap.description.tooltip: What the map is, for the map list in the game; several lines are fine
newmap.size.summary: {tiles, plural, one {# tile} other {# tiles}}, {metres, number, integer} × {metres, number, integer} m around tile 0, 0; more can be added beside the map later.
newmap.height.tooltip: The height of all terrain; roads and objects built later follow it
newmap.traffic.right.tooltip: Right-hand traffic, as in most of Europe
newmap.traffic.left.tooltip: Left-hand traffic, as in Britain: OMSI's [LHT]
newmap.cars.tooltip: How busy the streets are over the day, as a factor on the template's daily curve
newmap.passengers.tooltip: How many passengers wait at the stops, as a factor on the template's daily curve
newmap.real_rail.tooltip: Trams and trains follow the switches of their tracks: OMSI's [realrail]
newmap.first_year.tooltip: The first year a timetable may be set in
newmap.last_year.tooltip: The last year a timetable may be set in
newmap.year_offset.tooltip: Added to today's year when the game starts at the real date; Berlin-Spandau has -25 for the 1980s
newmap.money.tooltip: The money system: coins and notes the driver hands out
newmap.tickets.tooltip: The ticket pack: tickets passengers buy
newmap.season.snow.tooltip: Spring, summer, autumn and a winter with snow from January to early February
newmap.season.mild.tooltip: Spring, summer, autumn and a winter without snow
newmap.ground.none: No ground textures found; the template's ground stays.
newmap.ground.chosen: {texture} as the base ground; more ground textures are painted on later.
@newmap.ground.chosen: {texture} is the file name of the texture, shown unchanged
newmap.target: Creates {target} and opens it ready to edit; its project is made for you.
@newmap.target: {target} is the path of the new map folder, shown unchanged
newmap.problem.numbers: Ground height, years and year offset must be numbers.
newmap.problem.template: Choose a map of your OMSI installation as template; the new map goes next to it.
newmap.problem.name: Enter the name OMSI shows for the new map.
newmap.choose_template.title: Choose a map as template for the new map
